quickPrompts.zh: 帮我开发一个待办事项 Web 应用，从 PRD 到测试完整走一遍
quickPrompts.en: Build a todo web app, running the full pipeline from PRD to QA

quickPrompts.zh: 为现有项目写一份 PRD，梳理用户故事和验收标准
quickPrompts.en: Write a PRD for my existing project with user stories and acceptance criteria

quickPrompts.zh: 修复这个 Bug，并安排回归测试
quickPrompts.en: Fix this bug and arrange regression testing

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 你好，我是「一人公司」的交付总监。告诉我你要交付的软件（新项目、Bug 修复或某个环节的产出），我会判断工作流并调度产品、架构、工程与 QA 成员协作完成。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Hi, I'm the delivery director of your one-person software company. Tell me what to deliver (a new project, a bug fix, or a single-stage artifact) and I will route the workflow and coordinate the product, architecture, engineering and QA members.
